summary: Backend regression + new admin email diagnostic endpoints verified. All 18 pytest tests pass (8 new diagnostics + 10 email verification regression).
action_items: Root cause of user's non-delivered emails is almost certainly DNS/domain-verification on Resend for alpha-fit.fitness (SPF/DKIM/DMARC). Diagnostic tooling now in place; user must inspect production db.email_log_raw via GET /api/admin/email-diagnostics after redeploy and check Resend dashboard delivery status.
critical_code_review_comments: email_service.send_email correctly persists diagnostics fire-and-forget with a lazy Motor client; no circular-import issues.

Minor: error detection logic in send_email uses `result.get('error') or result.get('message') if result.get('statusCode') ...` — operator precedence makes `message` only checked when statusCode>=400, but `error` is checked unconditionally due to short-circuit — behavior is acceptable but non-obvious; consider parenthesising for clarity.
GET /admin/email-diagnostics `template_log` query when no email filter uses same `q` (which is empty) — fine, but when email is set uses different field name (`email` vs `to`) — correctly handled.
POST /admin/email-test always sends verification-template email; consider allowing subject/template override in the future. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed with test+<ts>@example.com; module-scoped cleanup fixture removes users, email_verifications, email_log, email_log_raw entries after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Diagnostic endpoints work as designed in preview env. To debug production non-delivery, admin should call GET /api/admin/email-diagnostics on prod and inspect raw_sends[].error / raw_sends[].raw for actual Resend responses. If raw response contains a valid email_id but user doesn't receive it, the problem is downstream (DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC on alpha-fit.fitness). No preview test-send was made to real user address per instructions.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this iteration only adds diagnostic tooling. Delivery failure RCA requires production data (see admin endpoint output) + Resend dashboard inspection.
